survey.basis: The existing source-checked NWS survey selection retains 336 outcomes inside or on the published outline. Its storm and survey dates do not establish individual impact times.

geography.basis: The replay supplies reviewed minute positions. The linked aerial-survey account describes a damage envelope, not visible funnel geometry.

damage.basis: Keep the mapped survey outcomes, aerial damage-envelope interpretation and individual roof-loss photograph separate from storm-time optical appearance.

gaps.basis: Keep the inherited figure-inspection record, discrete visual samples and aerial damage interpretation separate from an admitted appearance interval or visible funnel width. The full pinned dossier retains the other source and registration limits.
